# Migration from v2.x to v3.x

If you're asking yourself if and how you should plan the migration, you will find some information on this page about what changed, has been renamed or deprecated.

## General

### Minimal react version

We dropped support for react &lt;18 and now only support react v18 to v19.

### Inter font

Roboto font has been replaced with Inter font as required by [Airbus brand guidelines](https://brand.airbus.com/en/asset-library/typography)
(more details in <a href="https://design-system.airbus.corp/visual-styles/typography/">Typography guidelines</a>).<br />
To setup Inter font, refer to `Standard Font` section in <LinkTo kind="General/Welcome" story="docs">Welcome page</LinkTo>.

## Component status

Components that have been **renamed** in consistency with Figma UI Kit.<br />
v2 names are still supported with console warnings to facilitate migration.

| v2 name           | v3 name                                                                       |
| ----------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| RangeSlider       | <LinkTo kind="Components/Slider" story="docs">Slider</LinkTo>                 |
| ProgressIndicator | <LinkTo kind="Components/SlideIndicator" story="docs">SlideIndicator</LinkTo> |

## Visual changes

### Dark mode

One of the major visual change in v3 is the **updated design of dark mode for all components**.<br />
This change comes from the need to improve accessibility (color contrast), energy efficiency (screens power) and to support applications designed for full dark mode.<br /><br />

<a href="landingpage_dark.png" className="glightbox">
  <img src="landingpage_dark.png" width="460" />
</a>

All the dark mode examples in this documentation are using a background color set to `#111111` (token: surface.interaction.default.dark).<br />
This is the recommended color to use for the main dark surfaces, but it can vary depending on visual hiearchy.

See instructions on how to setup Dark mode in <LinkTo kind="General/Visual Styles/Introduction" story="docs">Visual styles Page</LinkTo>

### Header and Footer themes

We removed the <LinkTo kind="Components/Header" story="docs">Header</LinkTo> and <LinkTo kind="Components/Footer" story="docs">Footer</LinkTo> white theme to better align with the branding guidelines.<br />

- default theme stays the same (blue background)
- dark theme provide the new dark mode design

<div className="sbdocs-compare">
  <Source
    code={`// v2.x
// dark (default) : theme with blue background
<Header appName="App Name" />
<Footer />
// light : theme with white background
<Header appName="App Name" theme="light" />
<Footer theme="light" />
    `}
    language="jsx"
  />
  <Source
    code={`// v3.x
// light (default) : theme with blue background
<Header appName="App Name" />
<Footer />
// dark : theme with new dark mode
<Header appName="App Name" theme="dark" />
<Footer theme="dark" />
    `}
    language="jsx"
  />
</div>

### Negative variants

We also added `Negative` variants for some components to support **sections of the UI with dark color backgrounds in light mode**.<br />

This is needed for example for the Footer light mode on blue background. In the example below, links and Icon Buttons are using negative variants.<br /><br />

<a href="footer_negative.png" className="glightbox">
  <img src="footer_negative.png" width="460" />
</a>

Components that support `Negative` variants :

- <LinkTo kind="Components/Button" story="Negative">
    Button
  </LinkTo>
- <LinkTo kind="Components/Iconbutton" story="Negative">
    Icon button
  </LinkTo>
- <LinkTo kind="Components/Link" story="Negative">
    Link
  </LinkTo>
- <LinkTo kind="Components/Tabs" story="Negative">
    Tabs
  </LinkTo>

### Banner

Height of the banner is increased to 56px from 40px.
No change is needed from your side, but be aware that height of banner is increased.

### Toast

Unlike v2, in v3 the `Link` component used inside a `Toast` does **not** automatically receive `inline` and `size` props. You now need to explicitly set these props to ensure the link appears as intended.

<div className="sbdocs-compare">
<Source
  code={`// v2.x
import { Toast, Link } from "@airbus/components-react";
...
<Toast time="2:35 pm" title="New Features">
  We have some great new features to show you.{' '}
  <Link
    href="#"
    onClick={() => {}}
  >
    Let's go
  </Link>
</Toast>`}
  language="jsx"
/>

<Source
  code={`
  // v3.x
import { Toast, Link } from "@airbus/components-react";
...
<Toast time="2:35 pm" title="New Features">
  We have some great new features to show you.{' '}
  <Link
    href="#"
    inline
    onClick={() => {}}
    size="small"
  >
    Let's go
  </Link>
</Toast>`}
  language="jsx"
/>

</div>

## Icons

We have reduced the list of icons in `@airbus/icons@3.0.0` package, by removing Material icons except those consumed by components.<br />
For other Material icons, developers need to use 3rd party fonts or libraries.

More details in <LinkTo kind="General/Visual-Styles/Icons" story="docs">Visual Styles/Icons</LinkTo>

<div className="sbdocs-compare">
  <Source
    code={`// v2.x
import { Home, Warning } from "@airbus/icons/react";
...
<div>
  <Home />
  <Warning />
</div>
...
    `}
    language="jsx"
  />
  <Source
    code={`// v3.x
import { Warning } from "@airbus/icons/react";
// example using '@material-design-icons/svg' and 'svgr' libraries
import Home from "@material-design-icons/svg/filled/home.svg?react";
...
<div>
  <Home />
  <Warning />
</div>
...
    `}
    language="jsx"
  />
</div>
